profile.summary: Financial analyst with five years in FP&A at logistics and manufacturing companies. I build the forecasts and models that pricing, budget and capital decisions are made on, and explain them to people who don't live in Excel.

descriptions: Own the monthly forecast for a $240M freight division; operating income forecast error fell from 9% to 3% over four quarters
Built a driver-based Excel model for fuel and lane pricing that the CFO used to approve a 4% rate increase
Cut month-end variance reporting from five days to two by pulling data from three systems into one Power BI report
Prepared the capital request for a $6.5M warehouse expansion, with payback, downside and delay cases
Tracked spending against budget for 11 cost centers and sent plant managers a one-page overrun summary each month
Rebuilt the plant headcount model after a reorganization, removing about 40 hours of manual updates per quarter
Consolidated department submissions for the annual budget into a single file the controller reviewed line by line
Reconciled loan fee accounts each week and wrote up the three largest variances for the accounting manager
Coursework: Corporate Finance, Financial Modeling, Managerial Accounting, Econometrics
Modeling: Three-statement models, DCF, budgeting and forecasting, scenario analysis
Tools: Excel (Power Query, VBA), Power BI, NetSuite, Adaptive Planning
CFA: Passed Level I; Level II Candidate in the CFA Program

SUMMARY

Financial analyst with five years in FP&A at logistics and manufacturing companies. I build the forecasts and models that pricing, budget and capital decisions are made on, and explain them to people who don't live in Excel.
